reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.

The cited text supports compliance: §10 (p0065) provides a 'renewable one-year term' with no 'automatically renew' or 'unless either party gives notice' language anywhere in the cited material, so renewal effectively requires the parties' agreement in 12-month periods — the preferred position. There is no non-renewal notice window to compute and no multi-year auto-renewal, so neither the fallback nor walk-away thresholds are engaged.

The failed deterministic check (value=90) is a false positive: the 90 days in §17(b) is Sparkling's (the customer's) termination-for-convenience notice right, not a non-renewal notice window imposed on us. That provision benefits our party and correctly was not flagged.
The absent maintenance-fee uplift cap is correctly treated as a sub-element noted in the rationale rather than a deviation, consistent with the playbook's classification semantics.
